clusters.pick_reason: PR #2215 is a strict superset of #2214's fix. Both apply the same `/\/+$/` regex normalization in `buildWellKnownPath` and `buildDiscoveryUrls`. #2215 additionally: (1) extracts a named `normalizeDiscoveryPath` helper that handles the edge case where `pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')` on a root path `'/'` yields `''`, not `'/'`; and (2) updates the `shouldAttemptFallback` guard from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` to match the new normalized form — a correctness fix that #2214 omits. Without that guard update (as in #2214), root-path fallback prevention silently breaks because the normalized root is now `''` rather than `'/'`. PR #2215 also includes a test file change covering these cases.

members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both PRs replace the same `if (pathname.endsWith('/')) { pathname = pathname.slice(0, -1); }` guard in `buildWellKnownPath` and `buildDiscoveryUrls` with a regex-based strip (`replace(/\/+$/, '')`). The root cause they share: a single trailing-slash strip silently misbehaves when a pathname has multiple trailing slashes or when the path is exactly `'/'`.
